Yes. A damaged item is handled differently from a normal return.

A normal change-of-mind return for an online order has a 14-day window, and the item needs to be unused, in original condition, with packaging, tags and accessories intact.

If an item is damaged, faulty, or incorrect, it is not treated as a standard change-of-mind return. It’s reviewed separately in line with Australian Consumer Law, and the next steps depend on the issue.

For online orders, please report the issue through the Help Centre: https://www.toyworld.com.au/pages/help or via chat with your order details and a description of the damage. For in-store or Click & Collect purchases, the original store handles it first. 😊
